[d0195] config | ingress.compression | version 4.x
# `ingress.compression`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Compression codec that the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `zstd` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | ingress |

## Notes

Changes to `ingress.compression` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[ingress]
compression = "zstd"
```

---

[d0009] config | metrics.compression | version 4.x
# `metrics.compression`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Compression codec that the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `lz4` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | metrics |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `metrics.compression` only if you observe problems with the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
compression = "lz4"
```
